meta.title: TAU AI Club, Tel Aviv University
meta.description: Weekly meetups, Zero to Hero workshops and talks from industry. Cohort 02, 2026–27.
meta.ogAlt: TAU AI Club logo on a dark background

event.noUpcomingBody: The next season is on its way. Follow us on Instagram so you don't miss it.

season.title: The season
season.empty: No events in this season yet.
season.dialHint: Spin the dial, or use the arrow keys
season.subscribeTitle: The whole season in your calendar
season.subscribeBody: Subscribe once; new meetups and changes show up in your calendar on their own.

footer.follow: Not in the cohort? Follow us on Instagram for open events and the next cohort.

errors.dataUnavailable: We couldn't load the events right now. Try again in a moment.

calendarFeed.description: Every meetup of the TAU AI Club season. Updates on its own.

auth.loginBody: The club is closed to this cohort. Sign in with the Google account whose email is on the list.
auth.errorCancelled: Sign-in was cancelled. You can try again.
auth.errorFailed: Something went wrong signing you in. Try again in a moment.
auth.errorUnavailable: Sign-in isn't switched on for this site yet.
auth.membersOnlyBody: This part of the site is for members of the cohort. If you registered with a different email, sign out and sign in with that one, and we'll see you inside.
auth.membersOnlyGuest: Club members sign in with Google.
auth.membersOnlyFollow: Not in the cohort? Follow us on Instagram for open events and the next cohort.
auth.welcomeTitle: Hi {name}, welcome to the AI Club
auth.welcomeBody: You're signed in. From here you can see what's open to members of the cohort.
auth.membersOnlyFollowBody: On Instagram we post events that are open to everyone, and when the next cohort opens.

admin.membersBody: Only emails on this list can sign in. Changes apply on the next request.
admin.name: Name
admin.removeConfirm: Remove {name} from the club? Their access ends right away.
admin.importBody: Columns: email, full_name, role (member or admin). An email already on the list is updated, a new one is added. One bad row stops the whole import.
admin.errorEmailTaken: That email is already on the list.
admin.errorLastAdmin: You can't remove or demote the last admin.
admin.speakersBody: Create a single-use link and send it to the speaker. They choose what to share. Email and phone are visible to members only; LinkedIn is public only if the speaker opts in.
admin.speaker: Speaker
admin.linkReady: The link is ready. It's only shown now, so copy it:
admin.eventsBody: Every event in the season, drafts included. Saving updates the public site right away.
admin.speakerCount: {n, plural, =0 {no speakers} one {# speaker} other {# speakers}}
admin.eventFormBody: Guests only see published events. A draft and its speakers stay hidden.
admin.slugHint: Lower-case letters, digits and dashes. Changing it breaks old links.
admin.timeZoneHint: Times are Israel time (Asia/Jerusalem), whatever your computer's timezone.
admin.speakersOrderHint: Speakers show in this order. Leave a slot empty to skip it.
admin.deleteEventConfirm: Permanently delete “{name}”? Its line-up is removed too. This can't be undone.
admin.errorTime: Enter a start and end date and time.
admin.errorEndsBeforeStarts: The end has to be after the start.
admin.errorDuplicateSpeaker: The same speaker is listed twice.
admin.errorInUse: It's still in use, so it can't be changed or removed.
admin.venuesBody: Places events happen. Deleting a venue sets its events to “venue TBD”.
admin.eventCount: {n, plural, =0 {no events} one {# event} other {# events}}
admin.deleteVenueConfirm: Delete {name}? {n, plural, =0 {No events use it.} one {# event will show “venue TBD”.} other {# events will show “venue TBD”.}}
admin.speakerProfilesBody: Public speaker profiles. A speaker shows on the site only once they're on a published event. Contact details are collected separately, under Speaker contacts.
admin.deleteSpeakerConfirm: Delete {name}'s profile? This can't be undone.
admin.errorSpeakerOnEvent: This speaker is on an event's line-up. Remove them from the event first.
admin.errorPhotoHost: The photo has to be an https link on Supabase Storage (*.supabase.co).
admin.contactsEmpty: No speakers on this session yet. Pick speakers above and save, then you can ask them for contact details.
admin.missingContacts: {n, plural, one {# speaker without contact details} other {# speakers without contact details}}
admin.flyerBody: Upload the event flyer and the form below fills itself in as a draft. Check every field before you save; nothing is published automatically.
admin.flyerOff: Flyer reading isn't set up yet. Fill in the form by hand for now.
admin.flyerDone: The flyer was read. Review the details below.
admin.flyerLimits: PNG, JPEG, WebP or PDF, up to 10 MB. Faces are found in your browser; only the flyer itself is sent for reading.
admin.flyerErrorType: That file isn't a PNG, JPEG, WebP or PDF.
admin.flyerErrorForbidden: Only admins can read flyers. Sign in again if this looks wrong.
admin.flyerErrorRefused: The flyer couldn't be read. Fill in the form by hand.
admin.flyerErrorFailed: Reading the flyer didn't work. Try again, or fill in the form by hand.
admin.flyerErrorPhoto: A speaker photo couldn't be saved. Try again, or skip the photo.
admin.flyerErrorSpeaker: A new speaker couldn't be created. Check their name, or pick an existing speaker.
admin.flyerDefaultTimes: No time on the flyer: set to 18:00–20:00.
admin.flyerVenueNoMatch: (not a saved venue; added as a venue note)
admin.flyerCropLabel: Crop for face {n}. Drag, or use the arrow keys; + and - resize.
admin.flyerNoFaces: No faces found on the flyer. You can add photos later under Speakers.
admin.flyerPdfNoFaces: Photos can only be cropped from an image flyer, not a PDF.
admin.flyerApplyHint: New speakers are created now; the event is saved only when you save the form.
admin.flyerPrefilled: Filled from the flyer. Check every field, then save. It saves as a draft.

speakerForm.title: Hi {name}
speakerForm.intro: Thanks for speaking at the TAU AI Club. You can share contact details with us, and you decide on each one separately. Anything you don't tick isn't stored.
speakerForm.shareEmail: Share my email with club members
speakerForm.sharePhone: Share my phone number with club members
speakerForm.shareLinkedin: Share my LinkedIn profile with club members
speakerForm.linkedinPublic: Also show it on the public site
speakerForm.membersOnlyNote: Email and phone are visible only to signed-in members of the cohort, never to the public.
speakerForm.consent: I agree that the club stores the details I ticked and shows them as I chose. I can ask for them to be deleted at any time.
speakerForm.expires: This link works until {date} and can be used once.
speakerForm.doneBody: Your details are saved. If you want to change or delete them, write to us and we'll send a new link.
speakerForm.invalidBody: It may have been used already or expired. Ask us for a new one.
speakerForm.errorConsent: Please confirm your consent to send.
speakerForm.errorPhone: That phone number doesn't look right.
speakerForm.errorLinkedin: Please use a LinkedIn profile link (https://www.linkedin.com/...).
speakerForm.errorExpired: This link is no longer valid.
speakerForm.visibleMembers: Visible only to signed-in cohort members.
speakerForm.signoff: The TAU AI Club team, Tel Aviv University

profile.title: My profile
profile.body: Your profile is visible to members of the cohort only. Guests never see it.
profile.photoHint: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 2 MB. Only members can see it.
profile.linksHint: https links only. GitHub must be a github.com profile.
profile.errorYear: Pick a year from the list.
profile.errorLinks: One of the links isn't valid. Use full https addresses.
profile.errorPhotoType: That file isn't a JPEG, PNG or WebP image.
